about.md (468B)

anmo.garden

this is a file gallery. it is a mirror of the folder that hosts it.

every page here was written by src/grow.js, which walks the folder, looks at each file, and reads the icon positions that Finder stores in the invisible .DS_Store file sitting in each directory.

so the way things are scattered on this page is not a design decision made in CSS. it is wherever i dragged the icons in a Finder window.

to rearrange the site, rearrange the folder.

watch.sh (287B)

#!/bin/sh
# Regrow the garden whenever anything in it changes.
# Needs fswatch:  brew install fswatch
cd "$(dirname "$0")" || exit 1
node src/grow.js "$@"
fswatch -o -r --exclude 'index\.html$' . | while read -r _; do
  echo "--- change detected, regrowing"
  node src/grow.js "$@"
done
